text: After an intravenous dose it has an elimination half-life of about 11 to 12 days. ◊ References. 1. Vaishnaw AK, TenHoor CN. Pharmacokinetics, biologic activi- ty, and tolerability of alefacept by intravenous and intramuscular administration. J Pharmacokinet Pharmacodyn 2002; 29: 415–26. Uses and Administration Alefacept is a recombinant human fusion protein that binds to CD2 on memory T-lymphocytes, preventing their activation and reducing their number. It is used in the management of moderate to severe chronic plaque psoriasis (p.1583) and is given in a dose of 7.5 mg once weekly by intravenous injection, or 15 mg once weekly by intramuscular injection, for 12 weeks. A second 12- week course may be given if necessary, starting not less than 12 weeks after the completion of the first. ◊ General references. 1. Ellis CN, Krueger GG.
